warnings.t: WLD-01 / f1: set to 4 hosts but needs 18 (RAM).
WLD-01 / f1: RAID-6 4+2 (FTT=2) (auto) needs 6 hosts and the cluster has 4, so with a host in maintenance or failed, vSAN can't rebuild to full protection. Add a host for that.
WLD-01 / x1: max hosts 2 is below this cluster's minimum of 3 (storage, policy, topology and spares), so 3 is used. Raise the max.
WLD-01 / x1: RAID-5 2+1 (FTT=1) (auto) needs 3 hosts and the cluster has 3, so with a host in maintenance or failed, vSAN can't rebuild to full protection. Add a host for that.
WLD-01: 303 hosts and 12,410 VMs is beyond a medium vCenter (400 hosts / 4,000 VMs). Pick a larger vCenter.
